correctness.rationale: For k>1 cube connectivity forces alpha>0, integer off-color count t, and (k-1)t<=d; double-counting edges yields k|2^d and hence k=2^r. Conversely assign t copies of each nonzero F_2^r coordinate column plus zeros and color by the resulting surjective linear syndrome map; each desired off-color difference occurs exactly t times. The exact chi_FAT and proper-boundary corollaries follow. Replayed direct graph checker verifies 106 feasible triples and exhaustive 14 small parameter profiles, only as corroboration.

value.rationale: This is a complete feasibility classification of natural FAT coloring parameters on every binary hypercube, with a sharp power-of-two palette phase diagram, all integer tolerance levels, the proper-coloring divisibility boundary, and an exact unbounded gap against ordinary bipartite coloring. The construction is uniform and graph-natural; no arbitrary finite slice or known-table recomputation is claimed.
